arguments.value: A five-year consulting agreement under which Intermark Capital Corp. provides management and financial consulting services to Coral Gold Resources Ltd., through David Wolfin, starting February 1, 2020 and ending January 31, 2025 unless terminated earlier. Coral Gold pays a monthly consulting fee of $10,000 plus approved expenses and applicable taxes, with possible fee increases approved by the board compensation committee. The consultant must provide advisory, strategic, financial, reporting, and management support, help supervise senior management and operations, and support compliance and internal controls. The agreement can be ended by either side on notice, with special termination payments if Coral Gold ends it or if there is a change of control. The consultant must keep company information confidential, not solicit company employees for one year after termination, and assign any work product or intellectual property created under the agreement to the company. The consultant is an independent contractor, not an employee, must comply with laws, and both sides have indemnity obligations for certain losses. The agreement is governed by British Columbia law.
